description: Create a new user account in the Nx Witness VMS Web Admin at https://localhost:7001/static/index.html (credentials: admin/Admin1234!). The Users section is already open showing 6 existing users. To add a new user, hover over the 'Users' section header in the left sidebar until a small '+' (add) button appears at the right side of the header row, then click it. In the modal dialog that appears, fill in: Login (username) 'mike.chen', Full name 'Mike Chen', Email 'mike.chen@security.local', Password 'SecureVMS2024!', and set the Role to 'Viewer'. Click Create (or Add) to save. Confirm that the new user 'mike.chen' now appears in the users list in the sidebar.
